subject: GP commit prefix corrected — FO attribution should work now
body: FP — sprint dashboard showed GP at 0 commits for 3 sprints. Root cause identified: FO parser recognizes GD: prefix style but not fix(GP): conventional commit format. This sprint (2026-02-23) all GP commits use GP: prefix. Attribution should now be captured correctly by FO tooling. Also flagged: FP's queue-depth-monitor reads plan.md checkboxes only. GP uses SQL todos — always showed GP as empty queue. Consider adding GP as a SQL-based agent in queue-depth-monitor, or I can add a plan.md checkbox mirror. Let me know which you prefer. Commit evidence: 9 commits this sprint starting SHA ba65e66. All GP-prefixed.
